title: "Xenium Run QC Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: false
params:
  data_file: "report_data.RData"
  run_name: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Loads summary_df, overall_summary and outlier_text,
# written by spatial_reports_script.r
load(params$data_file)
```

`r if (nzchar(params$run_name)) paste0("**Run:** ", params$run_name)`

# Run Summary

```{r overall}
knitr::kable(
  overall_summary,
  col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
  align = c("l", "r")
)
```

# Region Metrics

```{r regions}
region_table <- summary_df[, c(
  "Region",
  "Cells_Detected",
  "Total_Transcripts",
  "Median_Genes_Per_Cell",
  "Median_Transcripts_Per_Cell",
  "Percent_Assigned"
)]

region_table$Cells_Detected <-
  format(region_table$Cells_Detected, big.mark = ",")
region_table$Total_Transcripts <-
  format(region_table$Total_Transcripts, big.mark = ",")
region_table$Percent_Assigned <-
  round(region_table$Percent_Assigned, 1)

knitr::kable(
  region_table,
  col.names = c(
    "Region",
    "Cells",
    "Transcripts",
    "Median Genes / Cell",
    "Median Transcripts / Cell",
    "% Assigned"
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Interpretation

Regions are flagged when any metric lies more than 2 standard deviations
from the run mean.

```{r interpretation, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", outlier_text, collapse = "\n"))
```
